The '''Mavinia system''' was located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the musical instrument known as the [[Mavinian cluster-wedding organ]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|295|Mavinian cluster-wedding organ}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Mavinian cluster-wedding organ]]|system=Mavinia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mavinia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
